inputs.text: In Hyderabad, Bharat Rashtra Samithi (BRS) Working President KT Rama Rao (KTR) accused the Congress government of corruption and failing to act against illegal mining on Sunday, March 29. KTR alleged that Raghava Constructions, a company belonging to Telangana Information and Public Relations Minister Ponguletti Srinivas Reddy, is involved in illegal mining.
